10.2.2 Farmer based interventions
Farmer-based soil and water conservation measures implemented in
individual fields were mainly carried out by constructing canals around
fields and constricting landforms useful for water conservation. Farmers

such as broad bed furrows, growing crops that are short in height, contour
farming etc. In addition to weeding techniques by building rectangular
bunds around 38 hectares of farm land and contour bunds against the slope
of the farm. They are able to preserve rain water. They are growing
Gliricidia (legume plants that grow in dry soil) to increase nitrogen levels

10.3 Natural resources around us
The Earth’s natural resources include air, water, soil, minerals, fuels,
plants, and animals. Conservation is the practice of caring for these
resources so all living things can benefit from them now and in the future.
All the things we need to survive, such as food, water, air, and shelter,
come from natural resources. Some of these resources can be replaced
after they are used and are called renewable resources. Other resources,
such as fossil fuels, cannot be replaced at all. Once they are used up, they

parsed_output.answer: It is important to recharge groundwater sources because they are a vital source of fresh water for drinking, agriculture, and other human needs. Groundwater is a renewable resource, but it can be depleted if overused without proper recharge. Recharging groundwater helps maintain a sustainable supply of water, especially in areas where water scarcity is a problem. For example, in the case study of Kothapally village, 28 dry open wells were recharged by building dykes or barriers in nearby canals and retaining rainwater in them. This helped in replenishing the groundwater and ensuring that the water was available for use. Recharging groundwater also helps in preventing the overuse of surface water sources like rivers, which may not be sufficient to meet the needs of a growing population. Additionally, it helps in maintaining the balance of the ecosystem and ensures that water is available for future generations.
